instruction: How to install Crossplane on a Kubernetes cluster
output: kubectl create namespace crossplane-system && helm repo add crossplane-stable https://charts.crossplane.io/stable && helm install crossplane --namespace crossplane-system crossplane-stable/crossplane

instruction: How to install Crossplane with alpha features
output: helm install crossplane --namespace crossplane-system crossplane-stable/crossplane --set alpha.features.deploymentRuntime=true

instruction: How to install a specific Crossplane version
How to install Crossplane with a custom registry
output: helm install crossplane --namespace crossplane-system crossplane-stable/crossplane --set image.pullSecrets={regcred} --set registry=registry.internal

instruction: How to install a Crossplane provider
How to install a Crossplane provider with a specific version
output:
kubectl apply -f - <<< 'apiVersion: pkg.crossplane.io/v1
kind: Provider
metadata:
  name: provider-aws
spec:
  package: xpkg.upbound.io/crossplane-contrib/provider-aws:v0.47.0'

instruction: How to install a Crossplane provider with a controller config
output:
kubectl apply -f - <<< 'apiVersion: pkg.crossplane.io/v1
kind: Provider
metadata:
  name: provider-aws
spec:
  package: xpkg.upbound.io/crossplane-contrib/provider-aws:v0.47.0
  controllerConfigRef:
    name: aws-config'

How to create a Crossplane ProviderConfig for AWS
output:
kubectl apply -f - <<< 'apiVersion: aws.crossplane.io/v1beta1
kind: ProviderConfig
metadata:
  name: aws-provider
spec:
  credentials:
    source: Secret
    secretRef:
      namespace: crossplane-system
      name: aws-creds
      key: creds'

instruction: How to create a Crossplane secret for AWS credentials
output: kubectl create secret generic aws-creds -n crossplane-system --from-file=creds=~/.aws/credentials

instruction: How to create a Crossplane secret for GCP credentials
output: kubectl create secret generic gcp-creds -n crossplane-system --from-file=creds=~/gcp-service-account.json

instruction: How to create a Crossplane secret for Azure credentials
output: kubectl create secret generic azure-creds -n crossplane-system --from-file=creds=~/azure-credentials.json
